adoption_decision: Do not promote candidate: improved supported-case acceptance comes with a new unsupported formula acceptance under the frozen protocol. Keep experimental; separately evaluate the useful missing-task-fact gate in a future frozen ablation.
limitations: Five interpretable author-constructed pairs, one flawed control; no independent expert labels or accuracy estimate.
